item_name: Rothco Air Corps Heavyweight Classic Messenger Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Air Corps Heavyweight Classic Messenger Bag blends durability and style, making it perfect for everyday use and great for travel. Crafted from unwashed, double-stitched cotton canvas, this messenger bag offers long-lasting strength while the distressed Air Corps symbol on the front provides a vintage touch. The spacious main compartment offers ample room for books, folders, tablets, and a small laptop, while 2 front open-top pockets, snap button side pockets, and an interior zippered pocket ensure easy organization of your items.
description: Rothco’s Air Corps Heavyweight Classic Messenger Bag blends durability and style, making it perfect for everyday use and great for travel. Crafted from unwashed, double-stitched cotton canvas, this messenger bag offers long-lasting strength while the distressed Air Corps symbol on the front provides a vintage touch. The spacious main compartment offers ample room for books, folders, tablets, and a small laptop, while 2 front open-top pockets, snap button side pockets, and an interior zippered pocket ensure easy organization of your everyday essentials. The front flap is secured with hook and loop closures, keeping your items safe and easily accessible. Featuring brass hardware for added durability and a 52-inch adjustable shoulder strap, this bag provides versatile carrying options as a shoulder or crossbody bag. Whether you're commuting, traveling, or using it as your go-to everyday bag, Rothco's messenger bag is built for comfort, convenience, and timeless style. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
